bibliographic.title: The Spelunking Trip
bibliographic.author: Chris Solaas
bibliographic.description: You've been excited about THIS trip for more than a month! Your troop is going on a caving expedition to Cumberland Caverns! You've just finished your homework for the weekend, and are all ready to pack for the trip. Being a newbie to the caving scene, you are glad that the troop provided a packing list for you. However, during the week you lost the list somewhere. So you'll either have to find the list or pack what you can remember from memory.
